body: {"hubDatabaseId":7,"sql":"SELECT C.COUNTRY, C.CITY, C.COMPANY_NAME, O.ORDER_NUMBER, O.ORDER_DATE, O.VAT_RATE, O.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS O JOIN CUSTOMERS C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE C.COUNTRY \u003C \u0027H\u0027 AND O.ORDER_ID % 3 = 0 ORDER BY C.COUNTRY, C.CITY, O.ORDER_ID","parameters":[]}
